comment: I had her for 221, she's honestly one of the most caring professors I've had a Richmond. She makes class interesting and gets to know students

Good professor. A lot of these posts say that she is easy, but that I would disagree. Overall very nice and willing to help. Exams are fair but sometimes a bit challenging. Not very much homework, but you will learn the material. Highly recommended.

Awesome professor. Makes class interesting.  At times it seems like she slacks off a little bit and tests seem rushed.  In the beginning of the semester it was very homework intensive but it seemed to drop off towards the end.  Do your homework and you will be fine. Easy professor!
Great teacher.. she's really helpful, nice and understanding. Class goes by fast, and she's not a hard grader.  HIGHLY recommended.
prof simpson rules! if you think this is an easy class, maybe you should hve gone to 302. Idiots. Her clss is challengig and fun for those who know they ar ein the right class!
if youve taken high school spanish the class is a breeze. studying really isnt important because she picks the simplest concepts for the tests..easy A

ridiculously easy. this class is a joke if youve taken spanish in high school. i have yet to study for a test or quiz and do all compositions the night before. class projects are really easy. shes a really nice woman just not that great of a teacher. easy A if youve taken spanish before
